docs: Initializes the alpha vault. `hotkey` is the single staking position for this
vault instance. `oracle_netuid` is the subnet whose registered neurons may
submit oracle prices. Governance must call `set_approved_netuid` to enable
vault creation for specific subnets.
constructors.label: new

docs: Emitted when the winning bid tokens are transferred out by the controller.
events.label: WinningBidTransferred

docs: Emitted when auction governance is transferred to a new account.
events.label: AuctionGovernanceUpdated

docs: Emitted when a bid is placed or raised on an auction.
events.label: BidPlaced

docs: Emitted when the admin account (allowed to bid on expired no-bid auctions) is updated.
events.label: AdminUpdated

docs: Emitted when a new liquidation auction is created.
events.label: AuctionCreated

docs: Emitted when a losing bidder withdraws their refund.
events.label: RefundWithdrawn

docs: Emitted when an auction is finalized, identifying the winning bidder.
events.label: AuctionFinalized

docs: Emitted whenever an owner sets or updates a spender's allowance.
events.label: Approval

docs: Emitted on token movement; `from = None` denotes a mint, `to = None` denotes a burn.
events.label: Transfer

docs: Emitted when oracle governance is transferred to a new account.
events.label: OracleGovernanceUpdated

docs: Emitted when the maximum allowed price deviation is changed.
events.label: MaxPriceDeviationUpdated

docs: Emitted when the minimum required submitter stake is changed.
events.label: MinSubmitterStakeUpdated

docs: Emitted when the governing subnet netuid is updated.
events.label: NetuidUpdated

docs: Emitted when a reporter submits (or replaces) a price for the current round.
events.label: PriceSubmitted

docs: Emitted when a round is committed and a new latest price is recorded.
events.label: RoundCommitted

docs: Emitted when the validator account is set or cleared.
events.label: ValidatorUpdated

docs: Emitted when alpha collateral is returned to the user.
events.label: CollateralReleased

docs: Emitted when borrowed tUSDT is repaid.
events.label: TokensRepaid

docs: Emitted when a new alpha-backed vault is opened.
events.label: VaultCreated

docs: Emitted when tUSDT is borrowed against a vault.
events.label: TokensBorrowed

docs: Emitted when alpha collateral is topped up on an existing vault.
events.label: CollateralAdded

docs: Emitted when interest is accrued onto a vault's debt balance.
events.label: InterestAccrued

docs: Schedules a per-netuid parameter update with the standard timelock.
Only governance may call.
messages.label: set_contract_params

docs: Executes the currently scheduled parameter update for a netuid once its timelock has elapsed.
messages.label: execute_contract_params_update

docs: Cancels the currently scheduled parameter update for a netuid. Governance only.
messages.label: cancel_contract_params_update

docs: Schedules a global (contract-wide) parameter update with the standard timelock.
Only governance may call.
messages.label: set_global_params

docs: Executes the currently scheduled global-parameter update once its timelock has elapsed.
messages.label: execute_global_params_update

docs: Cancels the currently scheduled global-parameter update. Governance only.
messages.label: cancel_global_params_update

docs: Adds or removes a netuid from the approved set. Only governance may call.
messages.label: set_approved_netuid

docs: Returns `true` if the given netuid is approved for collateral.
messages.label: is_approved_netuid

docs: Transfers surplus TUSDT held by the vault contract to the treasury.
Callable by governance or platform.
messages.label: claim_surplus_tusdt

docs: Claims excess alpha staking rewards on a subnet by unstaking them to native
TAO and transferring the TAO to the treasury. Governance only.
Excess = actual contract stake on the netuid minus total vault collateral on
that netuid (`netuid_total_collateral`).  If there is no excess, this is a
no-op (returns Ok).
messages.label: claim_excess_alpha

docs: Creates a new alpha-backed vault for the caller on the specified subnet by
atomically pulling `amount` of the CALLER's alpha stake (held under this
vault's hotkey) into the contract's custody via the caller-forwarded
`caller_transfer_stake` chain extension. No prior deposit intent or external
`transfer_stake` extrinsic is needed — the pull and the vault creation happen
in one message, so deposits are always attributed to the caller.
messages.label: create_alpha_vault

docs: Tops up an alpha vault's collateral by atomically pulling `amount` of the
CALLER's alpha stake (held under this vault's hotkey) into the contract's
custody. Exactly `amount` is credited to the caller's vault — unattributed
stake growth (emissions) remains claimable only by governance via
`claim_excess_alpha`.
messages.label: add_alpha_collateral

docs: Borrows tokens against the vault's alpha collateral.
messages.label: borrow_token

docs: Repays borrowed tokens from an alpha vault.
messages.label: repay_token

docs: Accrues any elapsed interest for a vault.
messages.label: accrue_interest

docs: Releases alpha collateral from a vault, returning the stake to a destination
coldkey via the chain extension. Validates that the remaining collateral still
satisfies ratio requirements.
messages.label: release_alpha_collateral

docs: Initiates a liquidation auction for an unsafe alpha vault. This first unstakes
the alpha collateral to native TAO via the chain extension, then creates a
standard Dutch auction with the recovered TAO.
messages.label: trigger_liquidation_auction

docs: Settles a finalized liquidation auction, transferring collateral to the winner,
routing accrued interest to the treasury, and burning only principal.
messages.label: settle_liquidation_auction
